title: The recovered response metric equals the carrier metric only at an unproved fixed point

statements.text: Linearizing about an admissible state gives a unique Lorentzian response metric in four dimensions, but its equality with the declared carrier metric is a coupled fixed-point condition that is stated and not yet proved.
statements.conditions: graded by the author as an open geometric closure gate

sources.quote: Equality of that response metric with the carrier metric remains a coupled fixed-point condition, while Einstein form is a selection result rather than a consequence of continuity alone.
That recovered response metric is distinct from the carrier metric until a coupled fixed point is proved.
